subject: Vendor orchestration kickoff — owners, timeline & MAP alignment
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: 2028-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: kickoff for vendor onboarding / PO and forms

Thanks Sergio — we are excited to get Nimbus set up on Redwood. A few things to help us coordinate:

- Main procurement contact (for PO): Elena Garcia (me) — procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
- Legal / commercial: Raj Patel (raj.patel@nimbus-analytics.com)
- Technical onboarding: Linh Tran (linh.tran@nimbus-analytics.com)

We can do a 30–45m kickoff this week. My availability (PST): Thu 03/09 10:00–11:30 or Fri 03/10 13:00–16:00.

Can you share the procurement checklist you normally use (PO fields, W9, invoicing cadence), plus a short MAP so stakeholders know milestones and owners?

I attached our internal vendor intake form (PDF) — happy to fill any Redwood forms.

Best,
Elena
Purchasing Manager
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: Nimbus_Vendor_Interest_Form.pdf (pdf)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: kickoff for vendor onboarding / PO and forms

Elena — appreciate the quick reply and the intake form. Attaching the Redwood vendor onboarding checklist and a first-pass MAP (mutual action plan) spreadsheet for Nimbus.

High-level agenda I propose for the kickoff (30–45m):
1) Introductions & roles (5m) — confirm who owns procurement, legal, tech.
2) PO requirements & invoicing cadence (10m) — fields we require, tax forms, billing contact.
3) Security/compliance gaps & evidence handoff (5m) — SOC2 report, IP/NDAs if needed.
4) MAP review: milestones, owners, target dates (10m).
5) Next steps & immediate asks (5m).

Proposed attendees from Redwood: Marissa Cole (Onboarding Lead), Karthik Iyer (Billing ops), Soojin Lee (Vendor Governance). I will run the MAP walkthrough.

Proposed times (PST): Thu 03/09 10:30–11:00, Thu 03/09 15:00–15:45, Fri 03/10 14:00–14:45. Please pick the best slot and loop in Raj and Linh if they can attend.

Immediate asks before the call:
- Completed W9 (or local equivalent) and vendor legal name for the PO
- Preferred invoice delivery (email vs. vendor portal) and remittance address
- Any third-party compliance questionnaires (if you want Redwood to pre-complete)

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.pdf, redwood_map_v0.9.xlsx

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbus-analytics.com, linh.tran@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: 2028-03-09T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: kickoff for vendor onboarding / PO and forms

Sergio / Elena — Raj here (legal). I'll join the kickoff but want to call out two items up front:

- We require a standard MSA redline window and a sample SOC2 report before vendor activation.
- Our PO usually needs a vendor tax ID + a completed W9 (US) or W-8BEN for non-US entities.

Thu 03/09 10:30 PST works for me; Linh will join for technical handoff. If you want to keep the call to 30 minutes, please prioritize PO fields + MAP milestones.

Thanks,
Raj Patel
Legal Counsel
Nimbus Analytics
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@nimbus-analytics.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, linh.tran@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: 2028-03-10T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Thu 03/09 10:30 PST — kickoff + pre-call checklist

Thanks everyone — confirming Thu 03/09 10:30–11:00 PST for the kickoff. Agenda (30m):
- Intros & roles (5m) — Sergio, Marissa, Raj, Elena, Linh, Karthik, Soojin
- PO / billing fields & W9 capture (10m) — Karthik will outline required fields; Elena please have vendor name exactly as you want it on the PO
- MAP review & timelines (10m) — confirm milestone owners and sign-off criteria
- Immediate actions (5m) — assign owners and dates

Pre-call deliverables (requested by EOD Wed 03/08):
- Vendor legal name + tax ID (Elena)
- Completed W9 (if US) or equivalent (Elena)
- Any redlines or special invoice terms to share with legal (Raj)
- Confirm technical point-of-contact and SSO/SCIM needs (Linh)

I attached an updated MAP (redwood_map_v0.9.xlsx) with pre-filled milestone owners — please review and add comments in the sheet before the call if possible.

Post-call plan: 1) Redwood sends PO template and onboarding packet; 2) Nimbus returns completed forms + W9; 3) Karthik opens billing account and schedules first invoice cadence. Target completion: 3 weeks after kickoff unless legal redlines extend timeline.

If anything changes, reply-all. See you Thu.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
